=== docs/01-product-brief.md
# A. Product brief: "Subscribe in three steps"

**Goal.** Raise web conversion from visitor to paid subscriber by 15% by the end of Q1.

**Flow.** Choose a plan, identify with eID, pay, done. The whole thing should take under two minutes. Seventy percent of our web traffic is on phones.

**Plans.** Basic, Standard and Premium. New customers get a 30-day free trial on Standard and Premium.

**Pricing.** Show consumer prices including VAT, per month, in euros.

**Accounts.** No sign-up form. The eID is the account. Existing subscribers who land on the page should be taken to their account instead.

**Markets and languages.** Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, in Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian and English. Latvia launches one month after the other two.

**Content.** Marketing must be able to change plan page copy, badges and the FAQ without an engineer.

**Later.** We will probably add promo codes and gift subscriptions, so please do not make those hard to add.
=== docs/02-api-notes.md
# B. API notes from the backend team

Base URL: `https://api.nordlight.example`. The web app is served from `https://www.nordlight.example`. Authentication is a session cookie set by the API after identity succeeds.

| Endpoint | Purpose | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /v1/plans?market=EE` | List plans for a market | Prices are `priceNet` in euro cents plus `vatRate` as a decimal. Plan ids look like `plan_std_m`. |
| `POST /v1/identity/sessions` | Start an eID login | Returns a `redirectUrl` to the eID provider. The provider sends the user back to `/auth/callback`. Sessions expire after 5 minutes. Rate limited; may return 429. |
| `GET /v1/me` | Current customer | 401 if not identified. Returns `customerId`, `activeSubscription` and `trialEligible`. |
| `POST /v1/orders` | Create an order | Body: `planId`. Returns `orderId` and a `paymentUrl` on the payment provider's hosted page. |
| `GET /v1/orders/{id}` | Order status | `pending`, `paid`, `failed` or `requires_action`. Status is updated by a provider webhook. "Usually a few seconds, occasionally minutes." |

Errors: the identity endpoint returns `{ "error": "message" }`. The orders endpoints return `{ "errors": [{ "code": "...", "message": "..." }] }`. We plan to unify these at some point.

The local mock server (`mock-server/`) implements these endpoints. See `mock-server/README.md` for how it behaves.
=== docs/03-cms-content-model.md
# C. CMS content model (headless CMS)

Content type **PlanPage**, one entry per market and language.

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headline`, `subhead` | Short text | Localised |
| `planCards[]` | List | Each has `planKey` (`basic`, `standard`, `premium`), `title`, `bullets[]`, `badge` and `priceLabel` |
| `priceLabel` | Short text | Free text, for example "from 7,99 € / month" |
| `legalText` | Rich text | Terms, withdrawal right and trial conditions |
| `faq[]` | List | Question and answer pairs |

The site is statically generated at deploy time and served from a CDN. A CMS publish triggers a rebuild. The Latvian entries exist but are partly empty.

Sample entries for every available market and language are in `fixtures/cms/` and are also served by the mock server at `GET /cms/v1/plan-pages?market=EE&locale=et`.
=== docs/04-analytics-notes.md
# D. Analytics notes from marketing

We use GA4 through Google Tag Manager. Please send these events and keep names exactly as written.

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_viewed` | Plan page is shown |
| `plan_selected` | User picks a plan |
| `identity_started` | User is sent to the eID provider |
| `identity_completed` | User returns identified |
| `payment_started` | User is sent to the payment page |
| `purchase` | Subscription is confirmed. Include `transaction_id`, `value` and `currency`. |

We also want to attribute purchases to campaigns, so UTM parameters should survive until `purchase`.
=== mock-server/README.md
# Nordlight mock server

A convenience built from the API notes in `docs/02-api-notes.md`. Where the notes are silent, the mock had to make a choice. The real services may differ, so treat anything you rely on here as an assumption to write down.

Everything is in memory. Restart the server, or `POST /__mock/reset`, to start clean.

## Choosing a scenario

A scenario decides how the mock behaves. Pick one in any of these ways. The first match wins:

1. The `x-scenario` request header.
2. A `?scenario=` query parameter. This also sets a `nl_scenario` cookie, so the choice sticks for later requests, including page navigations to the fake providers.
3. The `nl_scenario` cookie, which you can also set by clicking a scenario on the landing page (<http://localhost:4010>).
4. Otherwise `happy`.

When you create an identity session or an order, the mock remembers the scenario in force at that moment and uses it for the provider pages that follow.

| Scenario | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `happy` | Everything works. Payment is confirmed about 3 seconds after the customer pays. |
| `identity_cancelled` | The customer cancels at the eID provider. |
| `identity_slow` | The eID provider takes about 8 seconds to answer. |
| `rate_limited` | `POST /v1/identity/sessions` answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header. |
| `already_subscribed` | `GET /v1/me` reports an active subscription. |
| `not_trial_eligible` | `GET /v1/me` reports `trialEligible: false`. |
| `payment_declined` | The payment provider declines the payment. |
| `payment_slow` | Payment is confirmed about 45 seconds after the customer pays. |
| `payment_requires_action` | The provider asks for an extra authentication step before it confirms payment. |
| `api_500` | Every `/v1` endpoint except `GET /v1/plans` answers 500. |

## Endpoints

| Endpoint | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /v1/plans?market=EE` | Markets: `EE`, `LV`, `LT`. Returns `{ market, plans: [{ id, name, priceNet, vatRate, currency }] }`. |
| `POST /v1/identity/sessions` | Optional body `{ "returnUrl": "..." }`. Defaults to `WEB_ORIGIN/auth/callback`. Returns `{ sessionId, redirectUrl }`. |
| `GET /v1/me` | Needs the session cookie. Returns `{ customerId, activeSubscription, trialEligible }`. |
| `POST /v1/orders` | Body `{ "planId": "plan_std_m", "returnUrl": "..." }`. `returnUrl` is optional and defaults to `WEB_ORIGIN/payment/return`. Returns `{ orderId, paymentUrl }`. |
| `GET /v1/orders/{id}` | Returns `{ orderId, planId, status, createdAt }`. When the status is `requires_action` it also returns `actionUrl`. |
| `GET /cms/v1/plan-pages?market=EE&locale=et` | The CMS entry for a market and language. The same data is in `fixtures/cms/`. |

Return URLs must be on `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, or the configured `WEB_ORIGIN`.

## The fake providers

These are plain HTML pages that continue automatically after a short delay, with buttons if you want to click through by hand.

- **eID** at `/mock-eid/{sessionId}`. When it finishes, it sets the session cookie on success and sends the browser to your `returnUrl` with `?status=ok`, `?status=cancelled` or `?status=expired`.
- **Payment** at `/mock-pay/{orderId}`. When it finishes, it sends the browser to your order's `returnUrl` with `?orderId=...`, plus `&cancelled=1` if the customer pressed Cancel.

Payment results arrive separately, as they would from a webhook. Check the order status through the API.

Browsers on `localhost` share cookies across ports, so your app on `localhost:3000` can use the cookie the mock sets on `localhost:4010`.

## Debugging

- `GET /__mock/state` shows sessions, customers and orders as the mock sees them.
- `POST /__mock/reset` clears everything.
- Each request is logged to the console with its scenario and status code.
- CORS is enabled with credentials for `localhost` and `127.0.0.1` origins. Add more with `ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://a.example,https://b.example`.

- **eID** at `/mock-eid/{sessionId}`. When it finishes, it sets the session cookie on success and sends the browser to your `returnUrl` with `?status=ok`, `?status=cancelled` or `?status=expired`.
- **Payment** at `/mock-pay/{orderId}`. When it finishes, it sends the browser to your order's `returnUrl` with `?orderId=...`, plus `&cancelled=1` if the customer pressed Cancel.

Payment results arrive separately, as they would from a webhook. Check the order status through the API.

Browsers on `localhost` share cookies across ports, so your app on `localhost:3000` can use the cookie the mock sets on `localhost:4010`.

## Debugging

- `GET /__mock/state` shows sessions, customers and orders as the mock sees them.
- `POST /__mock/reset` clears everything.
- Each request is logged to the console with its scenario and status code.
- CORS is enabled with credentials for `localhost` and `127.0.0.1` origins. Add more with `ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://a.example,https://b.example`.

All 15 of your findings hold up. I found 14 more. Two corrections to yours: in #2, LT and LV Premium prices are wrong too, not only EE Standard; and in #9, the eID callback is undocumented as well, not only the payment return.

## Verification of your 15

| # | Verdict | Evidence / addition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | ✅ | Order body is `planId` only; same ids in all markets. The mock accepts any known id for any market, so LV can order `plan_prem_m`. No market, locale or currency in the order. |
| 2 | ✅+ | EE Std 899×1.24 = **11,15** vs CMS 10,99. Also **LT/LV Premium** 1299×1.21 = **15,72** vs CMS 14,99. "from" is misleading too: it's a flat monthly price. |
| 3 | ✅+ | `trialEligible` only comes from `/v1/me`. Add: digital content needs explicit consent to start at once and acknowledgement that the 14-day withdrawal right is lost. CMS `legalText` mentions withdrawal. |
| 4 | ✅ | Mock LV returns 2 plans; CMS LV has 3 cards (Premium empty); brief says 3. |
| 5 | ✅+ | Cookie is `HttpOnly` on the API domain, so JS can't read it. Needs a credentialed CORS `/v1/me` call from www. No account URL anywhere, yet the FAQ says "cancel in your account settings". Mock returns 409 `already_subscribed` on order. |
| 6 | ✅+ | Callback brings back only `?status=`. No state or nonce, no selected plan. The session cookie lands in whichever browser finished eID. |
| 7 | ✅ | `/v1/me` = `customerId`, `activeSubscription`, `trialEligible` only. |
| 8 | ✅ | No logout endpoint. No identity country in `/v1/me`. |
| 9 | ✅+ | API notes don't cover the payment `returnUrl` field, `?orderId`, `&cancelled=1`, `actionUrl` for `requires_action`, the eID `returnUrl`, or `?status=ok\|cancelled\|expired`. All exist only in the mock README. |
| 10 | ✅+ | LV.en: Premium empty, **legalText `[]`**, FAQ `[]`. LV.lv: Standard bullets empty, no badge, Premium title empty, legal and FAQ empty. Empty legal text is a compliance problem, not just cosmetic. |
| 11 | ✅ | No consent management tool (CMP) named; GA4 and UTM storage need consent first. |
| 12 | ✅ | Nothing stated. |
| 13 | ✅ | Mock `payment_slow` = 45 s. Even happy payment returns while still `pending` (3 s). |
| 14 | ✅+ | Also, nothing says how the **market** is chosen: path, domain, geo-IP or eID. |
| 15 | ✅ | Mock returns `currency: "EUR"`; the notes only say euro cents. |

## Full list, high → low

**P0: blocks correct money, legal or the build**
1. **Order has no market** (#1). Wrong VAT gets charged, and LV can order Premium.
2. **No price source of truth** (#2). CMS free-text `priceLabel` vs API net+VAT; 2 of 9 prices wrong. Rounding rule unspecified.
3. **Order API never returns amount, currency or trial flag** (new). `purchase` needs `value` and `currency`, and what's charged during a trial (0 €? card check?) is undefined.
4. **No Review/consent step** (#3): order-with-obligation-to-pay button, withdrawal waiver, trial terms.
5. **No consent mechanism** (#11). GA4 and UTM storage are blocked until one exists.
6. **Provider return contracts undocumented** (#9): eID and payment `returnUrl`, query params, `actionUrl`, cancel vs decline (mock turns cancel into `failed`).
7. **Cross-browser return after eID or payment** (#6), plus no `state` param, so login CSRF is possible and the callback can't be tied to the browser that started it (new).
8. **LV plan set conflict** (#4).

**P1: flow correctness**

9. Polling strategy and timeout UX (#13).
10. Existing-subscriber handling, account URL, CORS with credentials, 409 (#5).
11. **CMS `planKey` ↔ API `id` mapping undocumented** (`standard` ↔ `plan_std_m`) (new).
12. **Trial-per-plan not in the API** (new). Brief says Standard and Premium only; `/v1/plans` has no trial field and the CMS cards don't show it.
13. LV empty content, fallback, publish validation, pre-launch state (#10).
14. Market detection and locale in the URL (#14).
15. No email or contact channel (#7).
16. Logout, "not you?", eID country ≠ market (#8).
17. **Session TTL ambiguous** (new). Notes say "sessions expire after 5 minutes", which in the mock is the eID session; the auth cookie lives 1 h, and that's undocumented.
18. **Error contract** (new). Two formats, and no error-code catalogue: `already_subscribed`, `invalid_plan`, `unauthenticated`, `order_not_found`. The 429 `Retry-After` header is mock-only.
19. **No idempotency on `POST /v1/orders`** (new). A double tap makes two orders, and retry-after-decline is undefined.

**P2: quality and non-functional**

20. **Analytics gaps** (new). `purchase` has no dedupe on reload or polling, the other events have no parameters (`plan_id`, market, locale), and UTM storage is unspecified.
21. Accessibility (#12). The provider pages are outside our control.
22. **"Under two minutes" and 70 % mobile have no metric or performance budget** (new).
23. **Static CDN build vs live prices and status** (new). Prices baked in at build time can go stale.
24. **Language matrix unclear** (new). Brief says 4 languages; fixtures only have local + `en` per market.
25. **`legalText` rich-text schema undocumented** (new). Fixtures use `[{type, text}]`.

**P3: low**

26. `currency` missing from the notes (#15).
27. **Promo/gift extensibility** (new). The order body is `planId` only, and `_m` suggests annual plans later.
28. **Error-format drift beyond identity** (new). The mock uses `{error}` for plans, `/v1/me` and the CMS too.
29. **Mock `api_500` skips `/v1/plans`** (new). This implies plans are fetched at build time, which is undocumented.

Sources: Brief = `docs/01-product-brief.md`, API = `docs/02-api-notes.md`, CMS = `docs/03-cms-content-model.md`, GA = `docs/04-analytics-notes.md`, Mock = `mock-server/`.

## Sent to recruiter (2026-11-10)

| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 | `POST /v1/orders` takes only `planId`; ids are shared across EE/LV/LT but VAT differs (EE 24%, LV/LT 21%). How does the backend know the market: session or frontend? | Backend | Frontend sends `market` in order body. **Launch blocker.** Mock ignores extra fields; it also accepts any plan id in any market (LV can order `plan_prem_m`). | sent |
| Q2 | CMS `priceLabel` vs API price. EE Standard: CMS "from 10,99 €", API 899×1.24 = 11,15 €. Also LT and LV Premium: CMS 14,99 €, API 1299×1.21 = 15,72 €. Which is the source of truth? | Product + Marketing | API is the only price source. `priceLabel` not rendered. Price = `round(priceNet × (1 + vatRate))` cents, half-up, formatted per locale. "from" dropped (flat monthly price). | sent (LT/LV Premium not mentioned in the question) |
| Q3 | Trial eligibility and final price only known after eID. EU consumer law needs explicit consent and an "order with obligation to pay" button before payment. Can we add a Review step between eID and payment? | Product + Legal | Review step built behind feature flag `reviewStep` (default on). | sent |

## P0: blocks money, legal or build

| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q4 | Neither `POST` nor `GET /v1/orders/{id}` returns amount, currency or trial flag. What do we put in the GA `purchase` `value`/`currency`? What is charged on a trial order (0 €, card verification, first month)? | Backend + Product | `value` computed client-side from plan price; `0` when trial. `currency` from plans API. Trial order = card capture, 0 € charged now. |
| Q5 | No consent mechanism (CMP) named. GA4 and UTM storage need prior consent in the EU. Which CMP, and what happens before consent? | Marketing + Legal | GTM Consent Mode v2. No GA events and no UTM persistence before analytics consent. UTMs kept in memory/URL only until consent. |
| Q6 | Provider return contracts are only in the mock README, not the API notes: `returnUrl` in request bodies, eID `?status=ok\|cancelled\|expired`, payment `?orderId`, `&cancelled=1`, `actionUrl` on `requires_action`. Are these the real contracts? Can cancel be told apart from decline (mock marks cancel as `failed`)? | Backend | Mock behaviour is the contract. Cancel detected via `cancelled=1` only. |
| Q7 | Mobile eID app switch or in-app browsers (Instagram/Facebook) can return the user in a different browser: no cookie, no plan, no UTM. Also the callback has no `state` param, so it can't be bound to the originating browser (login CSRF). | Backend + Security | Plan, market, locale and UTM encoded in `returnUrl` query. If no session on return: show "continue in this browser" with restart. Request a `state` param from backend. |
| Q8 | LV: API returns 2 plans (no Premium), CMS has 3 cards, brief says 3. Which is right? | Product | API decides which plans exist. CMS cards without a matching API plan are hidden. |

## P1: flow correctness

| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q9 | Payment confirmation is "usually seconds, occasionally minutes". Polling interval, max wait, any push channel? What does the user see after N seconds? | Backend + Product | Poll `GET /v1/orders/{id}` every 2 s for 20 s, then every 5 s up to 3 min. After 20 s show "still confirming" message; after 3 min show "we'll confirm shortly" with safe exit. |
| Q10 | "Existing subscribers go to their account": only known via `/v1/me` (cookie is HttpOnly on the API domain) or after eID. Where is the account? Is a client-side redirect from the static page acceptable? | Product + Backend | Call `/v1/me` with credentials on load; on active subscription redirect to `ACCOUNT_URL` (config). After eID, same check; `409 already_subscribed` on order handled the same way. |
| Q11 | CMS `planKey` (`basic`/`standard`/`premium`) vs API `id` (`plan_basic_m`/…): mapping is undocumented. | Backend + CMS | Static map in frontend config. Request a `planKey` field on the API plan. |
| Q12 | Brief: trial on Standard and Premium only. API plans have no trial field; CMS cards don't show trial. | Backend + Product | Hardcoded trial plan set `{standard, premium}`, 30 days. Request `trialDays` on plan. |
| Q13 | LV CMS entries partly empty (LV.en: Premium empty, `legalText` and FAQ empty; LV.lv: Standard bullets empty, Premium title empty, legal and FAQ empty). No empty-field rule, no fallback language, no publish validation. What do LV visitors see before launch? | Marketing + Product | LV behind feature flag `market.LV` (off). Build fails if `legalText` empty for an enabled market. Empty optional fields hidden. No cross-language fallback. |
| Q14 | No URL rule for market and locale; no language selector mentioned. How is the market chosen (path, domain, geo-IP)? | Product + SEO | URL `/{market}/{locale}/` e.g. `/ee/et/`. Language switcher within market. Root redirects by `Accept-Language`, default `ee/et`. |
| Q15 | No sign-up means no email: no receipt, no "payment confirmed" message, no recovery contact. `/v1/me` has no name. | Product + Backend | Out of scope for the slice; confirmation page shows order id. Flagged as a launch risk. |
| Q16 | No logout or "not you?". What if the eID country differs from the site market? | Product + Backend | No logout in the flow. Market from URL, eID country ignored. Flagged. |
| Q17 | API notes say "sessions expire after 5 minutes", which is ambiguous. Mock: eID session 5 min, auth cookie 1 h. Auth session lifetime is undocumented. | Backend | eID session 5 min, auth session ≥ 1 h. `?status=expired` and `401` lead to restart from eID. |
| Q18 | Two error formats (`{error}` vs `{errors[]}`) and no error-code catalogue. Mock codes: `unauthenticated`, `invalid_plan`, `invalid_request`, `already_subscribed`, `order_not_found`, `internal_error`. `Retry-After` on 429 is mock-only. | Backend | One adapter normalises both shapes to `{status, code, message}`. Mock codes are treated as the catalogue. Honour `Retry-After`. |
| Q19 | No idempotency on `POST /v1/orders`: double tap = two orders. Retry after decline: new order or reuse? | Backend | Button disabled while in flight. New order per payment attempt. Request `Idempotency-Key` support. |

## P2: quality and non-functional

| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q20 | Analytics: no dedupe rule for `purchase` (reload, repeated polling), no params for other events, no UTM storage spec. | Marketing | `purchase` fires once per `orderId` (sessionStorage guard). All events carry `market`, `locale`, `plan_id` where known. UTMs carried with the flow (see Q5, Q7). |
| Q21 | No accessibility requirement. Provider pages are outside our control. | Product | WCAG 2.2 AA for our pages. |
| Q22 | "Under two minutes" and "70% on phones" have no metric or performance budget. | Product | Measure `plan_viewed` → `purchase` time. LCP < 2.5 s and INP < 200 ms on mid-range mobile. JS ≤ 150 KB gzip on the plan page. |
| Q23 | Static CDN build vs prices: are prices baked in at build or fetched at runtime? | Backend + Platform | Plans fetched at build for first paint, re-fetched at runtime before Review. Review price is binding. |
| Q24 | Brief: 4 languages. Fixtures: local + `en` per market only. Is every language available in every market? Russian? | Product + Marketing | Local + `en` per market, as in the fixtures. |
| Q25 | `legalText` rich-text schema undocumented (fixtures use `[{type, text}]`). | CMS | Only `paragraph` supported; unknown node types are skipped and logged. |

## P3: low

| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q26 | `currency` returned by the mock but not in the API notes. | Backend | Field exists; always `EUR`. |
| Q27 | Promo codes and gift subscriptions coming later; order body is `planId` only. `_m` suffix hints at annual plans. | Product + Backend | Order payload built by one function so fields can be added. No promo UI. |
| Q28 | The mock uses the `{error}` format on plans, `/v1/me` and CMS too, not only identity. | Backend | Covered by the adapter in Q18. |
| Q29 | Mock `api_500` doesn't affect `GET /v1/plans`, which implies plans are fetched at build. | Backend | See Q23. |

4. Review step UI polish (keep the consent checkbox + "Order and pay" button)

# CLAUDE.md

Nordlight: a subscribe flow (plan → eID → review → pay → confirmed) for EE/LV/LT. This is an assignment repo: the spec in `spec/` drives the code in `app/`. Read `ASSIGNMENT.md` for the deliverables and `PLAN.md` for phases and time budget.

## Source of truth

1. `spec/` beats `docs/` beats `mock-server/`. Where they disagree, follow the spec and say so.
2. `spec/open-questions.md` holds the working assumptions. Never invent behaviour: if something is not covered, add a question with an assumption to that file and tell the user.
3. Work from one item in `spec/08-work-items.md` at a time. Meet its acceptance criteria, nothing more.

## Do not edit

`docs/`, `fixtures/`, `mock-server/`, `ASSIGNMENT.md`, `.claude/hooks/`, `ai-log/`. The `ai-log/` folder is written by hooks and is evidence for `AI-LOG.md`.

## Stack

Next.js App Router with `output: 'export'` (static, no server code, no API routes, no middleware). TypeScript strict. npm. Vitest + Testing Library for unit tests. Playwright for E2E.

## Commands

```sh
npm run mock                     # mock API on http://localhost:4010 (root)
MOCK_TIME_SCALE=50 npm run mock  # fast, for E2E
npm run test:mock                # mock's own tests
cd app && npm run dev            # app on http://localhost:3000
cd app && npm test               # vitest
cd app && npm run e2e            # playwright (starts mock + app)
cd app && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
```

## Domain rules (from open-questions; do not change silently)

- **Price**: `Math.round(priceNet * (1 + vatRate))` cents, formatted with `Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: 'currency', currency })`. Never render CMS `priceLabel` (Q2).
- **Market**: always send `market` in the `POST /v1/orders` body (Q1). Plans shown are those the API returns. CMS cards without a matching API plan are hidden (Q8).
- **planKey map**: `basic` ↔ `plan_basic_m`, `standard` ↔ `plan_std_m`, `premium` ↔ `plan_prem_m`. One place in code (Q11).
- **Trial**: Standard + Premium, 30 days, only if `/v1/me.trialEligible` (Q12).
- **Errors**: one adapter turns `{error}` and `{errors:[{code,message}]}` into `{status, code, message}`. UI code never reads raw error bodies (Q18).
- **Flags**: `reviewStep` (default on), `market.LV` (default off).
- **Flow context** (plan, market, locale) travels in the `returnUrl` query, because return may land in another browser (Q7). sessionStorage is only a convenience.
- **Polling** `GET /v1/orders/{id}`: every 2 s for 20 s, then every 5 s, stop at 3 min (Q9).
- **URLs**: `/{market}/{locale}/` in lowercase, e.g. `/ee/et/`. Callbacks: `/auth/callback`, `/payment/return`.

## Mock gotchas

- Use `localhost`, never `127.0.0.1`, so cookies are shared across ports. Every fetch uses `credentials: 'include'`.
- Session cookie `nl_session` is HttpOnly: use `GET /v1/me` to find out whether the user is identified.
- Pick a scenario with the `x-scenario` header (tests) or `?scenario=` (browser). `POST /__mock/reset` between E2E tests.
- eID returns `?status=ok|cancelled|expired`. Payment returns `?orderId=…[&cancelled=1]`. Payment results arrive later, so poll.
- `requires_action` comes with `actionUrl`; send the browser there.

## Code style

- Small pure modules (state machine, price, error adapter) with unit tests next to them. React components stay thin.
- Clear names over comments. Comments only for non-obvious *why*, kept short.
- No new dependency without a reason stated in the PR or commit.
- All user-facing strings come from the CMS or a per-locale dictionary. No hardcoded English in components.
- Accessibility: semantic HTML, visible focus, `aria-live` for polling status, a 44px tap target minimum.

- Clear names over comments. Comments only for non-obvious *why*, kept short.
- No new dependency without a reason stated in the PR or commit.
- All user-facing strings come from the CMS or a per-locale dictionary. No hardcoded English in components.
- Accessibility: semantic HTML, visible focus, `aria-live` for polling status, a 44px tap target minimum.

# 01 · Scope

## Goal
A visitor in EE, LV or LT picks a plan, identifies with national eID, pays on
the provider's hosted page and lands in the app as a subscriber. No sign-up form.

Success = +15% visitor → paid conversion by end of Q1. There is no baseline
or funnel definition yet.

## Brief → scope
1. Choose plan, eID, pay, done | Plan → eID → **Review** → Pay → Done. Review is behind a flag 
2. Mobile-first, since 70% of users mobile
3. Basic / Standard / Premium plans with 30-day trial. The sourth of truth for plans and prices is API.
4. Prices incl. VAT, monthly. Prices are in EUR. Gross computed from `priceNet` and `vatRate` fields from API
5. eID is an account of user
6. Existing subscribers go to their account 
7. Initial launch is EE and LV, LT comes in a month
8. Marketing edits copy, badges, FAQ. All plan page copy from the CMS
9. Promo codes and gifts later. Should be easy to integrate later

## Non-goals
1. Promo codes and gifts
2. Sign-up form
3. Payment method UI, hosted by payment providers
4. Logout

## Wrong (fix)

- **Line 17: markets are flipped.** The brief says *Latvia* launches a month later, so the first launch is **EE + LT**. LV sits behind the `market.LV` flag.
- **Line 13: the trial isn't on all plans.** The brief gives the trial to **Standard and Premium only**, for new customers (`trialEligible`). Also a typo: "sourth" → "source".
- **Line 11: the table is broken.** The `|` inside a list item shows up as plain text. Either make "Brief → Scope" a real two-column table, or drop the brief column.
- **Filename.** The file is `1-scope.md`, but its heading and `PLAN.md` use `01-scope`. Pick one.

## Missing

1. **Markets and languages.** The brief lists 4 languages; the CMS fixtures only have local language + `en` per market (Q24). Also the URL `/{market}/{locale}/` (Q14).
2. **Market-specific VAT.** The order sends `market` (Q1). This is the #1 launch blocker, so it belongs in scope.
3. **Failure and recovery are in scope:** eID cancelled or expired, payment declined or cancelled, slow confirmation, extra payment authentication (`requires_action`), already subscribed. Without these an AI tool builds only the happy path.
4. **Analytics.** The 6 GA4 events, UTMs kept until `purchase`, and that both depend on consent (Q5). One line, with details in `05`.
5. **Accessibility and performance.** One line each, pointing to `05`.
6. **Secondary metric.** "Under 2 minutes" end-to-end, measured from `plan_viewed` to `purchase`.
7. **Where the flow ends.** "Lands in the app": the app/account URL isn't defined (Q10). Say the frontend hands off to a configured URL.
8. **Source of non-CMS copy.** The CMS only models `PlanPage`. Copy for Review, error and polling screens comes from per-locale dictionaries in the code.
9. **Spec scope vs slice scope.** Add a short "Thin slice" section, or link `PLAN.md`, so an AI tool doesn't build the whole spec when working on the slice.
10. **Links to open questions.** Tag the assumptions with their IDs (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q8, Q13), so reviewers can see what's still unconfirmed.

## Non-goals to add

- Email, receipts, notifications (Q15)
- Account management and cancelling a subscription (the FAQ points there, but it's another system)
- Backend, webhooks, eID and payment provider pages
- CMS schema changes (we consume the model as it is; changes go through open questions)
- Annual plans, currencies other than EUR, Russian
- Native apps

## Not needed / restructure

- **Item 9 and non-goal 1 say the same thing.** Keep promo/gift only as a non-goal, plus a constraint: "order payload built in one place so fields can be added".
- **Items 2 and 4 are constraints, not scope.** Move "mobile-first" and "EUR incl. VAT" into a short **Constraints** section.
- **Items 5–6 are vague.** "eID is the account" → identity = `customerId` from `/v1/me`; there's no profile data. "Existing subscribers go to their account" needs *when* (the `/v1/me` check on load, after eID, and a `409` on order) and *where* (a configured URL, Q10).
- **Logout as a non-goal** is fine, but link Q16 so the "not you?" risk stays visible.

Keep it at scope level: just list which failures the feature has to handle. How each one is handled belongs in `03-flow`. Text you can drop in:

```md
## Failure and recovery (in scope)
Every failure ends on a screen with a clear next action. The user never hits a dead end and never pays twice. Details in `03-flow.md`.

1. eID cancelled or expired → back to the selected plan, retry eID
2. eID rate limited (429) → wait `Retry-After`, then retry
3. Already subscribed (on load, after eID, or `409` on order) → redirect to account (Q10)
4. Payment cancelled or declined → back to Review, retry with a new order
5. Extra payment authentication (`requires_action`) → send to the provider's `actionUrl`, resume on return
6. Slow confirmation → keep checking, show a "still confirming" message, stop after a cap and show a safe exit (Q9)
7. Return in a different browser (eID app switch, in-app browser) → restore plan, market and locale from the URL; if not identified, restart eID (Q7)
8. API down (5xx) or network error → retry action; plan page still renders from the build
```

Two notes:
- **The rule in the first line** ("never a dead end, never pay twice") is what makes this testable. Each item becomes an acceptance criterion in `08` and a test case in `06`.
- **Not in scope:** fraud, chargebacks, refunds and withdrawal handling. Those are backend or support work. Add them to non-goals if you want them stated.

# Plan

Hard stop at 5:00. Clock started with discovery. Budget split follows the assignment: spec 60%, slice 30%, log + note 10%.

| Phase | Budget | Ends at |
|---|---|---|
| 0. Discovery: read docs/mock, list inconsistencies, send 3 questions | 0:30 | 0:30 ✅ |
| 1. Spec | 2:30 | 3:00 |
| 2. Thin slice | 1:30 | 4:30 |
| 3. AI-LOG, TEAM-NOTE, README | 0:30 | 5:00 |

No buffer is left. If a phase overruns, take the time from the cut list below. Never take it from phase 3.

## Decisions (2026-11-10)

- Stack: Next.js (App Router, `output: 'export'`), TypeScript, npm.
- Tests: Vitest + Testing Library (unit), Playwright (E2E) against the mock with `MOCK_TIME_SCALE=50`.
- Slice covers: happy path, `payment_declined`, `payment_slow` (polling), `identity_cancelled`/expired, `already_subscribed`, `payment_requires_action`.
- Review step is built behind the `reviewStep` flag (on by default) (Q3).
- All 6 market/locale pages are generated from CMS fixtures. LV is behind the `market.LV` flag (Q13).
- Order body sends `market` (Q1). Prices come from the API only, and `priceLabel` is not rendered (Q2).
- Out of the slice (spec only): analytics events + consent, UTM carry, language switcher UI, email/receipt.
- Open questions and working assumptions: `spec/open-questions.md`.

lines: +# Open questions and assumptions
+Status: `sent` = asked via recruiter, awaiting answer. `open` = not asked, working assumption applies. Each assumption is what we build until answered.
+Sources: Brief = `docs/01-product-brief.md`, API = `docs/02-api-notes.md`, CMS = `docs/03-cms-content-model.md`, GA = `docs/04-analytics-notes.md`, Mock = `mock-server/`.
+## Sent to recruiter (2026-11-10)
+| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption | Status |

+| Q1 | `POST /v1/orders` takes only `planId`; ids are shared across EE/LV/LT but VAT differs (EE 24%, LV/LT 21%). How does the backend know the market: session or frontend? | Backend | Frontend sends `market` in order body. **Launch blocker.** Mock ignores extra fields; it also accepts any plan id in any market (LV can order `plan_prem_m`). | sent |

+| Q2 | CMS `priceLabel` vs API price. EE Standard: CMS "from 10,99 €", API 899×1.24 = 11,15 €. Also LT and LV Premium: CMS 14,99 €, API 1299×1.21 = 15,72 €. Which is the source of truth? | Product + Marketing | API is the only price source. `priceLabel` not rendered. Price = `round(priceNet × (1 + vatRate))` cents, half-up, formatted per locale. "from" dropped (flat monthly price). | sent (LT/LV Premium not mentioned in the question) |

+| Q3 | Trial eligibility and final price only known after eID. EU consumer law needs explicit consent and an "order with obligation to pay" button before payment. Can we add a Review step between eID and payment? | Product + Legal | Review step built behind feature flag `reviewStep` (default on). | sent |
+## P0: blocks money, legal or build
+| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption |

+| Q4 | Neither `POST` nor `GET /v1/orders/{id}` returns amount, currency or trial flag. What do we put in the GA `purchase` `value`/`currency`? What is charged on a trial order (0 €, card verification, first month)? | Backend + Product | `value` computed client-side from plan price; `0` when trial. `currency` from plans API. Trial order = card capture, 0 € charged now. |

+| Q5 | No consent mechanism (CMP) named. GA4 and UTM storage need prior consent in the EU. Which CMP, and what happens before consent? | Marketing + Legal | GTM Consent Mode v2. No GA events and no UTM persistence before analytics consent. UTMs kept in memory/URL only until consent. |

+| Q6 | Provider return contracts are only in the mock README, not the API notes: `returnUrl` in request bodies, eID `?status=ok\|cancelled\|expired`, payment `?orderId`, `&cancelled=1`, `actionUrl` on `requires_action`. Are these the real contracts? Can cancel be told apart from decline (mock marks cancel as `failed`)? | Backend | Mock behaviour is the contract. Cancel detected via `cancelled=1` only. |

+| Q7 | Mobile eID app switch or in-app browsers (Instagram/Facebook) can return the user in a different browser: no cookie, no plan, no UTM. Also the callback has no `state` param, so it can't be bound to the originating browser (login CSRF). | Backend + Security | Plan, market, locale and UTM encoded in `returnUrl` query. If no session on return: show "continue in this browser" with restart. Request a `state` param from backend. |
+| Q8 | LV: API returns 2 plans (no Premium), CMS has 3 cards, brief says 3. Which is right? | Product | API decides which plans exist. CMS cards without a matching API plan are hidden. |
+## P1: flow correctness
+| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption |

+| Q9 | Payment confirmation is "usually seconds, occasionally minutes". Polling interval, max wait, any push channel? What does the user see after N seconds? | Backend + Product | Poll `GET /v1/orders/{id}` every 2 s for 20 s, then every 5 s up to 3 min. After 20 s show "still confirming" message; after 3 min show "we'll confirm shortly" with safe exit. |

+| Q10 | "Existing subscribers go to their account": only known via `/v1/me` (cookie is HttpOnly on the API domain) or after eID. Where is the account? Is a client-side redirect from the static page acceptable? | Product + Backend | Call `/v1/me` with credentials on load; on active subscription redirect to `ACCOUNT_URL` (config). After eID, same check; `409 already_subscribed` on order handled the same way. |

+| Q11 | CMS `planKey` (`basic`/`standard`/`premium`) vs API `id` (`plan_basic_m`/…): mapping is undocumented. | Backend + CMS | Static map in frontend config. Request a `planKey` field on the API plan. |

+| Q12 | Brief: trial on Standard and Premium only. API plans have no trial field; CMS cards don't show trial. | Backend + Product | Hardcoded trial plan set `{standard, premium}`, 30 days. Request `trialDays` on plan. |

+| Q13 | LV CMS entries partly empty (LV.en: Premium empty, `legalText` and FAQ empty; LV.lv: Standard bullets empty, Premium title empty, legal and FAQ empty). No empty-field rule, no fallback language, no publish validation. What do LV visitors see before launch? | Marketing + Product | LV behind feature flag `market.LV` (off). Build fails if `legalText` empty for an enabled market. Empty optional fields hidden. No cross-language fallback. |

+| Q14 | No URL rule for market and locale; no language selector mentioned. How is the market chosen (path, domain, geo-IP)? | Product + SEO | URL `/{market}/{locale}/` e.g. `/ee/et/`. Language switcher within market. Root redirects by `Accept-Language`, default `ee/et`. |

+| Q15 | No sign-up means no email: no receipt, no "payment confirmed" message, no recovery contact. `/v1/me` has no name. | Product + Backend | Out of scope for the slice; confirmation page shows order id. Flagged as a launch risk. |
+| Q16 | No logout or "not you?". What if the eID country differs from the site market? | Product + Backend | No logout in the flow. Market from URL, eID country ignored. Flagged. |

+| Q17 | API notes say "sessions expire after 5 minutes", which is ambiguous. Mock: eID session 5 min, auth cookie 1 h. Auth session lifetime is undocumented. | Backend | eID session 5 min, auth session ≥ 1 h. `?status=expired` and `401` lead to restart from eID. |

+| Q18 | Two error formats (`{error}` vs `{errors[]}`) and no error-code catalogue. Mock codes: `unauthenticated`, `invalid_plan`, `invalid_request`, `already_subscribed`, `order_not_found`, `internal_error`. `Retry-After` on 429 is mock-only. | Backend | One adapter normalises both shapes to `{status, code, message}`. Mock codes are treated as the catalogue. Honour `Retry-After`. |

+| Q19 | No idempotency on `POST /v1/orders`: double tap = two orders. Retry after decline: new order or reuse? | Backend | Button disabled while in flight. New order per payment attempt. Request `Idempotency-Key` support. |
+## P2: quality and non-functional
+| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption |

+| Q20 | Analytics: no dedupe rule for `purchase` (reload, repeated polling), no params for other events, no UTM storage spec. | Marketing | `purchase` fires once per `orderId` (sessionStorage guard). All events carry `market`, `locale`, `plan_id` where known. UTMs carried with the flow (see Q5, Q7). |
+| Q21 | No accessibility requirement. Provider pages are outside our control. | Product | WCAG 2.2 AA for our pages. |

+| Q22 | "Under two minutes" and "70% on phones" have no metric or performance budget. | Product | Measure `plan_viewed` → `purchase` time. LCP < 2.5 s and INP < 200 ms on mid-range mobile. JS ≤ 150 KB gzip on the plan page. |

+| Q23 | Static CDN build vs prices: are prices baked in at build or fetched at runtime? | Backend + Platform | Plans fetched at build for first paint, re-fetched at runtime before Review. Review price is binding. |
+| Q24 | Brief: 4 languages. Fixtures: local + `en` per market only. Is every language available in every market? Russian? | Product + Marketing | Local + `en` per market, as in the fixtures. |
+| Q25 | `legalText` rich-text schema undocumented (fixtures use `[{type, text}]`). | CMS | Only `paragraph` supported; unknown node types are skipped and logged. |
+## P3: low
+| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption |
+| Q26 | `currency` returned by the mock but not in the API notes. | Backend | Field exists; always `EUR`. |

+| Q27 | Promo codes and gift subscriptions coming later; order body is `planId` only. `_m` suffix hints at annual plans. | Product + Backend | Order payload built by one function so fields can be added. No promo UI. |
+| Q28 | The mock uses the `{error}` format on plans, `/v1/me` and CMS too, not only identity. | Backend | Covered by the adapter in Q18. |
+| Q29 | Mock `api_500` doesn't affect `GET /v1/plans`, which implies plans are fetched at build. | Backend | See Q23. |
